title: My first ever game is my dream DBZ racer
author: Fine-Combination5170
selftext:
Its a fast paced aggressive racer with multiple game modes.

The link is [https://wunnam-ak.itch.io/z-riders](https://wunnam-ak.itch.io/z-riders) if you wanna try it, i would love feedback

I went for the ps1 look for style what do yall think?

replies.author: MOAVG
replies.body:
You should watch a few videos on UX and UI for game development. You won’t have to compromise user experience and interaction with difficulty to read. This is why we have tests and QA to make sure we gain honest feedback and to try to improve the gameplay experience.   
Hopefully this works out for you!

comments.author: Kashmakers
comments.body:
This actually seems really fun! Powering attacks to attack other racers is a fun little gimmick.

But falling off the track while flying is nonsensical. It's Dragonball, people fly. I recommend having an HP bar instead; gradually decreases when off the track (let's the player skip a few sections in a strategic way to sacrifice some HP for a shortcut!). Getting hit with abilities would also decrease HP. Then just find a penalty for having 0 HP; maybe they need to power up their ki standing still for a moment to regain their HP.

Design wise, you want the timer, leaderboard and ki to have no background. Give the font an outline, and it looks much better, and you can see more of the track. The speed can likely be removed entirely; no one really needs to know how fast they're going.

Other than that, really neat idea to get to race with your favourite Dragonball character!

Request: add a playable Bulma in a Capsule airplane to race along with the others. Shooting missiles to other racers.
